title: CAFFEINE + THEANINE
style: clean modern product photography, soft diffused daylight, shallow depth of field, matte surfaces, muted natural palette, minimal composition, crisp focus, high detail

music.tags: hopeful rising strings, arpeggiated piano, soft swelling brass, gentle percussion, uplifting, instrumental

beats.prompt: A dark espresso being poured into a small white cup, close-up, warm side light, steam rising
beats.motion: The coffee pours and swirls. Steam rises.
beats.caption: It hides tiredness, it does not add energy

line.text: Caffeine blocks the signal that makes you feel tired. It does not add energy - it hides the debt.

beats.prompt: A cup of green tea beside a window in soft morning light, gentle steam, calm composition
beats.caption: Theanine is why tea feels smoother

line.text: Green tea carries theanine alongside it, which is why tea tends to feel smoother than the same caffeine from coffee.

beats.prompt: A desk with a notebook, pen and a cup, warm lamp light, focused working mood, shallow focus
beats.motion: Light steadies. A page lifts slightly.
beats.caption: Steadier attention, less jitter

line.text: Together they show up in the research as steadier attention with less of the jittery edge.

beats.prompt: An empty cup beside a dark window at night, low warm light, quiet and still
beats.motion: Very still. A faint reflection moves.
beats.caption: Afternoon coffee is tomorrow's tiredness

line.text: The catch is the same as always: it has a long tail, and afternoon coffee is tomorrow's tiredness.
